headline: AYA GOLD & SILVER SETS QUARTERLY RECORD: 1.49MOZ AT ZGOUNDER IN Q2, TOTAL OUTPUT SURGES 61% TO 1.68MOZ AGEQ (TSX:AYA)
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver (TSX: AYA) reported July 8 that Zgounder Silver Mine in Morocco poured a record 1.49 million ounces of silver in Q2 2026 — up 43% year-over-year and 18% quarter-over-quarter — while the Boumadine pyrite reclaiming operation contributed an additional 0.19 million silver equivalent ounces, lifting consolidated Q2 output to a record 1.68Moz AgEq (+61% YoY). Processing averaged 3,889 tonnes per day (7% above Q1's rate) at 141 g/t feed grade and 91.2% silver recovery — an operational profile that makes Zgounder one of the highest-throughput primary silver mines in Africa.

headline: RADISSON OBLITERATES O'BRIEN PROJECT RECORD: 1,604 G/T AU OVER 1.0M WITHIN 316 G/T OVER 5.1M — ABITIBI DEEP EXTENSION (TSXV:RDS)
snippet: Radisson Mining Resources (TSXV: RDS) reported July 7 that hole OB-26-385W4 at the O'Brien Gold Project in Quebec's Abitibi returned 316.31 g/t Au over 5.1 metres including a 1.0-metre interval at 1,603.95 g/t Au — the highest assay ever recorded in the project's history — targeting the deep extension of vein mineralisation in Piché Group rocks beneath the historic O'Brien Mine East workings. The intercept is one of three holes released within a fully-funded 140,000-metre step-out program testing down-plunge extensions of this former high-grade Abitibi producer; confirming grade at this depth in a fresh structural corridor is the geological signal that justifies continued drilling toward a resource expansion in what is already a well-delineated high-grade system.

headline: US'S LARGEST URANIUM DEPOSIT LAUNCHES PRE-FEASIBILITY DRILL — EAGLE NUCLEAR AURORA 32.75MLBS INDICATED, OREGON (NASDAQ:NUCL)
snippet: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. (NASDAQ: NUCL) announced July 8 it has engaged BBA USA Inc., SLR International, and Yukuskokon Professional Services to support a Pre-Feasibility Study at the Aurora Uranium Project on the Oregon–Nevada border — the largest open-pit-constrained measured and indicated uranium resource in the United States at 32.75 million pounds indicated and 4.98 million pounds inferred, defined across 500+ drill holes. A 47-hole / 27,000-foot drill program commencing this month will feed a PFS targeted for H2 2027, advancing Aurora into the credentialled development pipeline at a moment when US-domestic uranium sourcing is transitioning from a preference to a procurement requirement for utilities.

headline: OR ROYALTIES Q2 PRELIM: 20,757 GEOS, $97.8M REVENUE AT 96.8% CASH MARGIN, NET DEBT TRIMMED TO $139M (TSX:OR)
snippet: OR Royalties Inc. (TSX: OR) reported preliminary Q2 2026 results on July 8 — 20,757 attributable gold equivalent ounces delivered, generating $97.8 million in royalty and stream revenues at a 96.8% cash margin, with cost of sales excluding depletion of just $3.1 million for the quarter. Net debt declined to $139.4 million after $18 million in scheduled repayments, with $435 million of undrawn revolving credit capacity remaining — a balance sheet that positions OR to execute on opportunistic royalty acquisitions in a market where producers are increasingly willing to monetise royalties to fund capital programs at current gold prices.

headline: CASCADIA CARMACKS FIRST 2026 ASSAYS: 106.62M AT 1.09% CUEQ INCL. 23M AT 1.42% CU — ZONE PUSHED 60M NORTH, OPEN (TSXV:CAM)
source_name: Investing News Network / Cascadia Minerals Ltd.
snippet: Cascadia Minerals Ltd. (TSXV: CAM) released the first 2026 assays from Carmacks Copper-Gold in central Yukon on July 7, with Hole CD-26-046 at Zone 2000S returning 106.62 metres at 0.79% Cu and 0.28 g/t Au (1.09% CuEq), including a 23.15-metre interval at 1.42% Cu and 0.51 g/t Au — extending Zone 2000S northward by 60 metres with mineralisation open at depth and along strike, within a 15,000-metre season program now 8,000 metres complete. Carmacks is a permitted past-producing copper mine in Yukon adjacent to existing infrastructure; wide, consistent sulphide-hosted copper mineralisation that remains open laterally and at depth is exactly the profile that commands serious developer attention in the current structural supply-deficit environment.

headline: ALKANE FY2026: 168,337 OZ AUEQ IN TOP HALF OF GUIDANCE, CASH CLIMBS $104M TO $432M AT TOMINGLEY (ASX:ALK)
snippet: Alkane Resources Ltd. (ASX: ALK) reported July 7 that the Tomingley Gold Complex in New South Wales delivered 168,337 gold-equivalent ounces for FY2026 — placing the company in the upper half of its 160,000–175,000 oz guidance range — including 42,491 oz AuEq in the June quarter as cash, bullion, and investments grew by $104 million to $432 million at quarter close. For an unhedged ASX mid-tier with $432 million in liquid assets and a production rate building toward 175k oz, the combination of top-half operational delivery and a cash-rich balance sheet in the current gold price environment creates meaningful optionality for either brownfields expansion at Tomingley or an M&A move before Alkane's July 21 guidance review.

headline: SPROTT'S HEMKE: 2026 GOLD AND SILVER LOWS ARE IN — OIL ROUND-TRIPS $110 TO $68, IRAN INFLATION PREMIUM FADES
snippet: Craig Hemke of Sprott Money argued in a July 7 Kitco analysis that the late-June price lows are almost certainly the 2026 cycle lows for gold and silver, as crude oil has round-tripped from a $110 Iran-war premium back to $68 — removing the inflation overhang that drove Fed rate-hike pricing and suppressed metals for four months. Hemke's recovery thesis is conditional rather than aggressive: chart damage is significant, all key moving averages remain above spot, and he explicitly rules out a V-shaped recovery — flagging instead a sideways consolidation that gradually rebuilds sentiment and resets the technical picture, with any meaningful recovery rally more likely to emerge in late Q3 or Q4 2026.

headline: ISS BACKS $327M ELEMENTAL-VIZSLA ROYALTY MERGER — VOTE CLOSES TODAY ON PANUCO SILVER-GOLD STREAM DEAL (NYSE:ELE)
snippet: Institutional Shareholder Services and Glass Lewis both recommended voting FOR Elemental Royalty Corp.'s (NYSE: ELE) C$327 million acquisition of Vizsla Royalties Corp., with the Vizsla shareholder vote deadline closing July 8 — the deal's final remaining hurdle before a targeted Q3 2026 close. The transaction adds Vizsla's 2%–3.5% NSR royalty on the Panuco Silver-Gold Project in Mexico's Sinaloa state to Elemental's producing portfolio, expected to contribute approximately 7,500 gold equivalent ounces annually at steady-state — an accretive bolt-on at a 31% premium to Vizsla's unaffected share price that accelerates Elemental's transition toward a multi-stream, income-generating royalty company.

headline: CPM GROUP WARNS: GOLD AND SILVER AT KEY RESISTANCE — INVESTOR SELLING AND DOLLAR BREAKOUT COULD CAP RECOVERY
snippet: Jeffrey Christian of CPM Group published a cautionary July 7 Kitco piece warning that gold and silver have reached key technical resistance levels where the weight of institutional selling, a US dollar that has confirmed a sustained break above 100 on the DXY, and ongoing Fed hawkishness from the Hormuz oil shock could cap any summer recovery attempt before it gains traction. Christian's framework is the direct counter-view to Hemke's same-day bullish analysis: where Hemke sees the oil round-trip as removing the inflation premium that depressed metals, Christian sees the dollar's confirmed breakout as an independent suppression mechanism that persists regardless of oil price normalisation.
